provenance: Independent source-context review of PR 62 on 2026-10-11; original ledger items retained verbatim here, excluded from graded reconciliation.

evidence.excerpt_ar: قدر ما خالطه هذا إن عرف ربه وإلا تصدق به عن ربه وما بقي حلال.
evidence.note: Kashshāf (ghaṣb mixture): when the owner is known the mixture is a partnership and he may not divide it unilaterally; when unknown he gives the share in charity and the rest is lawful - no suspension by proportion (position 1, with the known-owner proviso).

items.reason: Owner-knownness is absent from case facts. Kashshaf distinguishes permission of the known owner from charity for an unknown owner; it cannot unconditionally instantiate takeOut.

evidence.excerpt_ar: (وضعفت) على سارقه (قيمته) أي: المسروق من ثمر أو طلع أو جمار أو ماشية
evidence.note: Sharḥ al-Muntahā: the doubled value is limited to fruit, spathe, palm-pith or livestock taken from outside a ḥirz - position 1 (with livestock added).

items.reason: This excerpt affirms doubling for specified goods, not single compensation for other goods. Preserve the passage without assigning it to the opposite ruling.
